faq.subtitle: Cannot find your answer? Send us a message.

items.a: Yes. Food logging with macros, steps, water, weight, sleep and basic workouts are free. Premium adds micronutrients and AI food photo scan. Pro adds the AI coaches Jai and Jaya, the planner and reports.

items.q: How do I install FitMe on Android?
items.a: Open the Download page on your phone, tap Download APK and open the file. If Android asks, allow your browser to install apps, then tap Install.

items.q: Can I use FitMe on iPhone?
items.a: Yes. Open the Download page on your iPhone for the current option. You can always use FitMe in Safari and add it to your Home Screen.

items.q: Can I use FitMe on my computer?
items.a: Yes. Choose Continue in browser. Your logs sync between the browser and the phone app. Automatic steps and heart rate need the phone app.

items.q: Which watches and health apps work with FitMe?
items.a: On Android, any watch or app that shares with Health Connect. On iPhone, Apple Health. Your phone can also count steps on its own.

items.q: What happens to my health data?
items.a: It is used only to show your progress inside FitMe. It is never sold or used for advertising. You can export or delete it from Settings.

items.q: Does the AI coach give medical advice?
items.a: No. Jai and Jaya help with fitness and food habits. They do not diagnose or advise on medication, and they suggest seeing a doctor when symptoms need it.

items.q: How do I delete my account?

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: This page explains what FitMe, made by Sindulis Innovative Solutions, does with the data you choose to give it.

p: To sync your logs we keep your name, email or phone number, country, language and the goals you set. You can change them in Settings.
Food, water, weight, sleep, workouts and notes are stored in your private FitMe account so they are on every device you sign in on. Nobody else can read them.

sections.h: Health data from Apple Health and Health Connect
p: Only after you connect it in Settings, Connected devices, FitMe reads steps, distance, active energy, heart rate, sleep, workouts and weight. FitMe never writes to Apple Health or Health Connect.
It is used only to show your activity, sleep and progress in FitMe and to give you suggestions inside the app. It is never sold, never used for advertising and never shared with third parties.
You can disconnect at any time, change permissions in Apple Health or Health Connect, and delete synced entries or your whole account in Settings.
When you record a workout route, your location is used to draw the map and measure distance. It is saved only with that workout.

When you scan a meal, the photo is sent securely to our server and to the AI service that estimates the foods, then discarded. It is not stored. You check and correct the result before anything is saved.
When you chat with Jai or Jaya, your message and a summary of your goals and recent logs are sent to the AI service to write the answer. Chats are saved in your account so you can read them again.
Payments are handled by Apple, Google or Cashfree. We never see your full card details. Free members of the mobile app may see ads; ads never use your health data.
You can download your data and delete your account from Settings. Deleting the account removes your logs, photos and settings. Write to us from the Contact page with any question.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.intro: By using FitMe you agree to these terms.

p: FitMe helps you track food, activity, sleep and habits. It is not a medical device and does not give medical advice, diagnosis or treatment.
Keep your sign-in details safe. You are responsible for what is logged in your account. You must be at least 13 years old, or older where local law requires it.
Premium and Pro are paid subscriptions with the price shown before you pay, in your currency. They renew until you cancel. The free trial is offered once per account.
Do not misuse FitMe, try to access other people's data or interfere with the service. We may suspend accounts that do.
We may update the app and these terms. We will tell you in the app about important changes.
FitMe is provided by Sindulis Innovative Solutions. Write to us from the Contact page.

refund.title: Refunds and cancellation
refund.intro: You can cancel a FitMe subscription at any time.

p: Cancel in the app under Settings, Plan, or in your App Store or Google Play subscriptions. You keep access until the end of the period you paid for.

sections.h: Refunds for App Store and Google Play
p: Purchases made through Apple or Google are refunded by them under their rules. Request a refund from Apple or Google directly.
For payments made on the website, write to us from the Contact page within 7 days of the charge if something went wrong. Approved refunds go back to the original payment method.
